cards.back: to make the most of; to take advantage of
cards.note: Hay que aprovechar el buen tiempo. — We should make the most of the good weather.
Aprender un idioma es un desafío. — Learning a language is a challenge.
Irregular stem pus-: puse, pusiste, puso, pusimos, pusisteis, pusieron.
Quieren que yo haga la cena. — They want me to make dinner.

cards.front: ¿Por o para? Which one do you use for a deadline, and which for how long something lasted?
cards.note:
Lo necesito para el lunes. — I need it by Monday.
Viví en Chile por dos años. — I lived in Chile for two years.
Echo de menos a mi familia. — I miss my family.

cards.back: I don't mind. / It's all the same to me.

cards.front: ¿Me puedes echar una mano con esto?
cards.back: Can you give me a hand with this?
cards.note: echar una mano = to lend a hand

cards.front: Ayer {{c1::fui::ir}} al mercado y compré fruta.
cards.back: Yesterday I went to the market and bought fruit.
cards.note: Pretérito of ir: fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fuisteis, fueron.

cards.front: Si {{c1::tuviera::tener}} más tiempo, {{c2::viajaría::viajar}} por toda Sudamérica.
cards.back: If I had more time, I would travel all over South America.
cards.note: Unreal “if” sentences: si + imperfect subjunctive, then the conditional.
